Home.heroTitle: Freight and parcels, <accent>priced before you commit</accent>
Home.heroSubtitle: Get a complete cost breakdown in seconds. Freight, fuel, insurance, customs, and handling each appear on their own line. Then follow your shipment from pickup to delivery with updates that tell you what happens next.
Home.svcAirDesc: For time-critical cargo. Priority routing on international lanes, with clearance handled alongside the booking.
Home.svcSeaDesc: The economical choice above roughly 500 kg. Slower than air, substantially cheaper per kilogram on volume.
Home.svcRoadDesc: Domestic and regional movement, plus the first and last mile that connects to every air and ocean route.
Home.svcWarehouseDesc: Secure storage between legs, with inventory handling for businesses shipping repeatedly on the same lanes.
Home.featPricingDesc: Freight, fuel, insurance, handling, customs, and tax are itemised at quote time. No figure appears on your invoice that you have not already seen.
Home.featTrackingDesc: Each milestone states what happened, where, and what comes next, so you are never left interpreting a status code on your own.
Home.featInsuranceDesc: Coverage is calculated from your declared value rather than sold as a flat add-on, so you pay in proportion to what is actually at risk.
Home.featSupportDesc: Live chat and a ticket system with full shipment history attached, so you are not repeating your tracking number to every new agent.
Home.whySub: Most logistics providers promise reliability. Here is what that means in practice on this platform.
Home.pricingTitle: Every line of your invoice, before you book
Home.pricingP1: Hidden fees are the most common complaint in freight, and they usually arrive after the cargo is already moving, when refusing is no longer realistic.
Home.pricingP2: We calculate the full breakdown at quote time and show it to you in full. Base freight reflects your route, weight, and mode. Fuel and insurance are percentages you can see. Customs appears only where the route requires it.
Home.pricingB1: Volumetric weight flagged whenever it applies to your package
Home.pricingB2: Currency shown in your local denomination, converted at quote time
Home.pricingB3: The approved total is the invoiced total, with nothing added later
Home.sampleNote: Illustrative figures. Your quote is calculated from your actual route, weight, dimensions, and declared value.
Home.modesSub: Speed and cost pull against each other. Here is when each mode is the right call. We select it automatically from your shipment details, and explain why.
Home.howSub: Four stages. You are told what is required at each one before you reach it.
Home.how1Text: Enter route, weight, dimensions, and declared value. The full itemised cost returns in seconds.
Home.how2Text: Review the breakdown, confirm pickup details, and pay by bank transfer, PayPal, or crypto.
Home.how3Text: Each milestone records what happened, where, and when, plus the next expected step.
Home.how4Text: Confirmation is logged with the full status history retained for your records.
Home.coverageP1: International shipping fails at the handoffs: between carriers, at borders, on the last mile. We work through vetted regional partners so each leg is handled by people who operate that lane routinely.
Home.coverageP2: Your tracking timeline stays continuous across every handoff, so a change of carrier never means a gap in visibility.
Home.coverageB1: Status updates written in plain language, not carrier codes
Home.coverageB2: Optional insurance and secure handling for sensitive cargo
Home.coverageB3: Delivery estimates given as a date range, not a single optimistic day
Home.coverageNote: Coverage varies by cargo type and service level. Enter your route on the quote page to confirm availability.
Home.trustSub: Three areas where shipments most often go wrong, and what we do about each.
Home.trust1Text: Cargo is scanned at each transfer point, so if something is delayed or misrouted we can identify exactly where it happened rather than guessing.
Home.trust2Text: Premiums are calculated from your declared value. Accurate declaration matters, because it determines both your premium and your maximum recovery.
Home.trust3Text: Incomplete paperwork causes more delays than any other factor. We tell you what each destination requires before dispatch, not after a shipment is held.
Home.whoSub: The platform handles a single parcel and a recurring freight programme on the same rails.
Home.who1Text: Sending personal effects, gifts, or documents across borders. No account minimums and no contracts. Quote, pay, and ship.
Home.who2Text: Shipping orders to international customers. Consistent tracking your buyers can follow themselves, plus warehousing between restocks.
Home.who3Text: Moving inventory, equipment, or high-value cargo on repeat lanes. Volume pricing and insurance sized to what you are actually moving.
Home.readyP1: Start with a quote. It costs nothing, takes about a minute, and shows you the complete cost before you commit to anything.
Home.readyP2: If the numbers do not work for you, you have lost a minute. If they do, your shipment is booked and tracking from the same page.
Home.faqSub: The things customers actually ask before their first shipment.
Home.faq1q: How is my shipping cost calculated?
Home.faq1a:
Your quote is built from six components: base freight, a fuel surcharge, insurance on your declared value, a handling fee, customs clearance where the route requires it, and any applicable tax.

Each line is shown separately before you book, so you can see exactly what you are paying for rather than a single unexplained total.

Nothing is added later. The figure you approve is the figure on your invoice.
Home.faq2q: Why is my quote higher than the weight I entered suggests?
Home.faq2a:
Carriers charge on whichever is greater: the actual weight of your package, or its volumetric weight, which is length × width × height in centimetres divided by 5000.

A large, light package occupies space that cannot be sold to anyone else, so it is priced on the space it takes rather than what it weighs.

When volumetric weight applies to your shipment, we say so on the quote and show both figures, so the higher price is never a surprise.
Home.faq3q: How do I track my shipment?
Home.faq3a:
Enter your tracking number on the Track page. You will see a timeline of every stage the shipment has passed through, each with a timestamp and location.

Every entry states what happened and what happens next, rather than leaving you to interpret a status label.

If a shipment is held at customs, the timeline says why and what is required to release it.
Home.faq4a:
Yes, on routes that require it. Clearance is priced into your quote rather than billed as an unexpected charge later.

We tell you which documents are needed before dispatch, because incomplete paperwork is the single most common cause of delay in international shipping.

If additional documentation becomes necessary in transit, you will be contacted directly rather than left to discover it from a stalled tracking page.
Home.faq5a:
Insurance is calculated from the declared value you enter at quote time and appears as its own line on your invoice.

Declaring an accurate value matters. Under-declaring reduces your premium but caps what can be recovered if something goes wrong.

For high-value or fragile cargo, contact support before booking and we will advise on the right level of cover.
Home.faq6a:
Bank transfer, PayPal, and major cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, USDT, and Ethereum. Available methods are shown on your invoice.

Every invoice carries a unique payment reference. Include it with your transfer so we can match your payment without delay.

After paying, upload your receipt from the payment page. We verify it and confirm by email, and your shipment status updates automatically.
